prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Overhead still life of a tidy ordered grid of blank paint-swatch and paper-sample cards in whites and blues, each card with a small six-sided hexagon die-cut, matching spacing throughout. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one swatch card in solid amber enamel. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
prompts.figure: Editorial documentary photograph of a calm working session around a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, soft north-window daylight, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Framed from the chest down so that no head is in the frame: one person only, in a navy sweater, standing at a long pale table, forearms on the table, one hand sliding a swatch card into place, in front of a tidy ordered grid of blank swatch cards with small hexagon die-cuts. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: one swatch card of the grid in solid amber enamel. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
